title: Q: show me, don't tell me
persona: CS 3410 student at lecture 2 (numbers), Prelim 1 Thursday. You learn visually. Whenever the tutor explains something only in speech, say 'don't just talk at me, write it down / show me a worked example'. You're happy when you see worked steps or a table on the page, and then you ask a follow-up about one step.
